caption: A birthday cake with lit candles is carried across a room, and the flames lean backward as it moves and stand up when it is set down.

sa.check: A cake with lit candles is carried across a room.
The flames lean backward as the cake moves.
All the flames lean the same way.
The flames flicker as the cake moves.

pc.expect: The flames trail opposite to the cake's direction of travel while it moves and return to upright once it stops.
pc.fail: The flames lean forward in the direction the cake is travelling; or the flames stay leaning after the cake is set down; or the flames lean while the cake stands still; or each flame leans a different way at the same moment.

pc.expect: With the cake still the flames point upward from their wicks and the wax pools at each candle's top.
pc.fail: A flame points downward with the cake still; or a flame hangs below its wick; or melted wax climbs a candle's side; or the flames lie flat while the cake stands still and nothing moves.

pc.expect: The flames stay alight through the carrying unless blown out, and once out a candle stays out.
pc.fail: A candle goes out and relights by itself; or a flame shrinks to nothing and returns with each step; or every flame goes out as the cake is set down gently; or a wick's glow brightens into a flame with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: The flames are soft tongues that stretch and waver and the candles stay upright in the cake's icing.
pc.fail: A flame holds a fixed rigid shape as it leans; or a candle bends with the movement; or a candle sinks into the icing and stays sunk; or a flame breaks into solid pieces.

pc.expect: The candles keep their number and places in the cake and each keeps one wick and one flame.
pc.fail: A flame separates from its wick and floats; or a second flame appears on one wick; or a candle vanishes; or a new candle appears in the cake.

pc.expect: The cake's icing, the candles' colours and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The icing changes colour or pattern; or a candle changes colour; or items in the room rearrange.

note: Whoever carries the cake is not judged.
